english:
Aiming Down Sights with <strand/>Strand Weapons grants 25%|40%|50% Flinch Resistance.

Flinch Resistances from different sources are multiplicative with each other.

source.text:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons, while ADS:

25% | 40% | 50% Flinch Resistance.

Flinch Resistances are multiplicative with each other.
